top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: 'Medieval' US Firing-Squad Execution Will Hurt Republicans in Midterms: Reid
top_signals.summary: A proposed public firing-squad execution discussed by the US defense secretary is a “medieval” idea that could damage the Republicans ahead of the midterms, according to Morris Reid, Partner at Actum, who served in the Clinton Administration. Speaking to Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse", Reid says this shows a lack of coordination within the Trump administration as it braces for "challenging" elections. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: SpaceX’s $750 Billion Rally Breaks Stock Out of Post-IPO Funk
top_signals.summary: SpaceX investors are finally getting some reprieve after months of being whipsawed by volatility as the Elon Musk-led company’s stock breaks above the level it’s been stuck below since July.

top_signals.title: ASOS: Hackers tricked way into employee account before sending rogue push notification
top_signals.summary: The company said its investigation, carried out with external experts, found the attackers had accessed “some personal information, including names and contact details, and certain non-personal account related information.”
